question: Valerio: mass = how much the vacuum presses the lines of spacetime inside a particle. Precise, measured counterpart: the pressure p(r) and shear s(r) inside the proton (energy-momentum tensor, gravitational form factor D(t)). Compute them for the Skyrme knot already built in NODO_3D and compare.

conventions.units: Skyrme units of knot_core: energy F_pi/(4e), length 2/(e F_pi) (hbar=c=1, ANW F_pi convention).
conventions.static_density: e = e2 + e4, e2 = tr D, e4 = 1/2[(tr D)^2 - tr D^2], D_ij = d_i phi . d_j phi
conventions.stress_tensor: derived from L = g^mn a_mn - 1/2[(g^mn a_mn)^2 - a_mn a^mn], metric (+,-,-,-): T_ij = 2 D_ij + 2 trD D_ij - 2 (D^2)_ij - delta_ij e;  p = T_ii/3 = (e4 - e2)/3; hedgehog: s = T_rr - T_thth = 2 (f'^2 - sin^2 f/r^2)(1 + sin^2 f/r^2). Must coincide with Cebulla et al. NPA 794 (2007) 87, eqs. (26),(27) (checked by P1e).
conventions.D_term: D = M int d^3r r^2 p(r) = -(4/15) M int d^3r r^2 s(r) (Polyakov-Schweitzer, IJMPA 33 (2018) 1830025); Cebulla/BEG use d1 = (5/4) D. Dimensionless: D = M~ I~ / (4 e^4) with M~, I~ in Skyrme units. M = classical soliton mass (large-Nc, as Cebulla), declared.
conventions.trace: T^mu_mu = T00 - T_ii = 2 e2 (the quartic Skyrme term is traceless, like a radiation gas / classical gluons).

BEG2018.ref: V.D. Burkert, L. Elouadrhiri, F.X. Girod, Nature 557 (2018) 396
BEG2018.verified_in_session: d1(0) = -2.04 +- 0.14 (stat) +- 0.33 (syst), form d1(t) = d1(0)(1 - t/M^2)^-alpha with alpha = 3, zero crossing 'near 0.6 fm', repulsive peak of r^2 p near 0.25 fm, binding peak near 0.8 fm, peak pressure 'about 1e35 Pa' (text of arXiv:1906.09419 sec. on DVCS + OSTI abstract of the Nature paper).
BEG2018.NOT_verified: M^2 = 1.02 GeV^2 is quoted from memory (primary text not reachable this session). Consistency check done before runs: tripole gives r0 = 3/M = 0.586 fm and r^2 p peak at (3-sqrt3)/M = 0.248 fm, matching the verified text.
BEG2018.D_from_d1: D = (4/5) d1 = -1.632 (leading Gegenbauer term; quark part only, mu^2 = 1.4 GeV^2; Kumericki, Nature 570 (2019) E1 argues the data are also compatible with zero)
BEG2018.pressure_formula: p(r) = 1/(6M) r^-2 d/dr r^2 d/dr D~(r), D~(r) = FT of D(t); tripole closed form p = D0 M^5 (u-3) e^-u / (192 pi m_N), u = M r.

Cebulla2007.ref: C. Cebulla, K. Goeke, J. Ossmann, P. Schweitzer, Nucl. Phys. A 794 (2007) 87, hep-ph/0703025
Cebulla2007.decomposition_chiral: int r^2 p (4-deriv) = - int r^2 p (2-deriv) = 13.7 MeV

Lattice2024.ref: D.C. Hackett, D.A. Pefkou, P.E. Shanahan, PRL 132 (2024) 251904, arXiv:2310.08484

MassDecomp.ref: Y.-B. Yang et al. (chiQCD), PRL 121 (2018) 212001; X. Ji, PRL 74 (1995) 1071
MassDecomp.note: lattice, MSbar 2 GeV; Ji's 1995 decomposition gives a similar split

ANW.status: FIT from M_N and M_Delta (NODO_3D.md), not a prediction

P1.what: exact hedgehog (knot_core.radial_bvp, R=60): T00, p, s in Skyrme units
P1.a: int T00 d^3r = M (= radial_bvp E): rel. diff < 1e-6
P1.b: von Laue |int r^2 p dr| / int r^2 |p| dr < 1e-3
P1.c: p(0) > 0, exactly one sign change of p, negative tail (p<0 for all r > r0 up to r = 50)
P1.d: D from p and from s agree to 2 %
P1.e: sanity vs literature: at Cebulla chiral-limit parameters (e=4.628, F=131.3 MeV) reproduce T00(0), p(0), r0, d1 of their Table 2 within 2 %

P2.what: physical units with ANW FIT e=5.44, F_pi=129 MeV; compare with proton (BEG tripole, D = 0.8 d1)
P2.b1: p(0) within a factor 2 of 1e35 Pa (headline number of BEG)
P2.b2: p(0) within a factor 2 of the BEG tripole p(0) (same closed formula, M^2 = 1.02 GeV^2)
P2.c: D within the Skyrme-model literature band [-5.28, -3.58] (Cebulla chiral limit / m_pi=138, D=0.8 d1)

predicted_before_running.p0: 0.317 GeV/fm^3 * (5.44/4.628)^2 (129/131.3)^4 = 0.41 GeV/fm^3 = 6.5e34 Pa -> b1 PASS expected, b2 (tripole p(0) ~ 1.2 GeV/fm^3 = 1.9e35 Pa) FAIL expected (ratio ~ 2.9)
predicted_before_running.D: D scales as 1/e^4: -5.28*(4.628/5.44)^4 = -2.77 -> c FAIL expected (ANW e is larger than Cebulla's e; closer to BEG -1.63 and lattice -3.87(97))

P3.a: virial E2 = E4 to 1e-4 relative (equivalent to int p d^3r = 0)
P3.b: int T^mu_mu d^3r = 2 E2 = M to 1e-4; Skyrme-term trace = 0 pointwise to 1e-12
P3.c: Tolman mass int (T00 + 3p) d^3r = M to 1e-4
P3.report: fractions: E2/M ('field energy', pressure -e2/3, pulls in) vs E4/M ('pushing term', pressure +e4/3, like light); compared qualitatively with chiQCD 2018 percentages, no fit

P4.what: lattice knot B=1, h=0.2, L=48 relaxed with knot_core.relax_lbfgs (as K1); p from 4th-order central derivatives, shell averaged around the baryon centroid, bins of width h/2
P4.a: core (r <= r0/2 of the ODE): max |p_lat - p_ode| / p_ode(0) < 5 %
P4.declare: tail: lattice box Dirichlet at half side 4.7 truncates the 1/r^6 pressure tail; lattice von Laue int p d^3r reported, not graded

P5.a: G M^2/R / (M c^2) with M = 939 MeV, R = 0.6 fm in [1e-40, 1e-38] (expected ~2e-39)
P5.b: Tolman active mass of radiation rho + 3p/c^2 = 2 rho (factor exactly 2)

parameters: zero free parameters in Skyrme units; 2 fitted (e, F_pi from ANW) for MeV/fm/Pa; BEG tripole 3 parameters taken from the paper, not refitted.
